name: german-amharic-learning-platform
description: Full-stack German language learning platform for Amharic speakers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-tests.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
